statement: Pricing of the good-base reset of the tilted odd share s_theta. A dense base whose fibres are long enough for Paper B's localized theorems (y^(1-2^(u-1)) >= y^(1/2)) needs an even step at walk height u <= 0; the next letter is Paper-B-controlled iff the effective height (odd letters since the last good base) is <= 3 and the effective depth <= 4. On the tilted walk-live measure (fair coin; DP reproducing pressure_direct's mu_4 to 6e-17) the honest reset leaves 0.80-1.00 of the tilted live mass uncontrolled at 1e12-1e100 (at 1e12 the band u > -0.526 forbids every good base) and crosses the budget 2p_C-1 only near L = 45, y = 10^(10^14), at C = 20. Charging the tower bias beta to the measure as well as to the bound, every rule with a Paper-B-controllable complement has tolerance beta* = p_C + O(1/d) (0.6016/0.6162 vs p_C 0.5994/0.6163 at 1e50; the same at L = 80): a pool splitting above 0.533 has tilted odd probability above log2/log3, climbs, is never reset, and its mass outgrows the fair population's once beta > 1/2. The reset split reduces M_{theta,q} to H_q on the uncontrolled towers at q = p_C; the any-E rule's tolerance 0.78 belongs to a complement that is not Paper B. The fair-coin room of any reset rule is the beta=1/2-in-the-measure, beta=1-in-the-bound inconsistency. CLOSE. Not a halt theorem.

Even steps never deepen the Juggler floor tower. For every j, Nat.sqrt^[j] x = s iff s^(2^j) <= x < (s+1)^(2^j) (sqrt_iter_eq_iff); on an even run floorPower is iterated Nat.sqrt (floorPower_iter_of_even); an odd step followed by j even steps equals Nat.sqrt^[j+1] (n^3), i.e. floor(n^(3/2^(j+1))) with one floor and no nesting (floorPower_odd_even_run, floorPower_odd_even_run_eq_iff); the OE fiber of FateContagion is the case j = 1. Hence the orbit value after a word is a nested tower with one level per odd letter and exponents 3/2^(j_r+1) fixed by the even runs: the tower height is the odd count, not the depth. Kernel-checked; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.
